settings.title: Tell us about your occasion
settings.text: Share your plans, preferences, and the details that matter to you.

settings.title: Meet your stylist
settings.text: Explore fabrics, fit, and personal details together.

settings.title: Make it yours
settings.text: Your made-to-order look is refined through the fitting process.

settings.question: What happens in a style session?
settings.answer: Your stylist learns about your occasion and preferences, then helps you explore a made-to-order look.

settings.question: How long does a consultation take?
settings.answer: Session length depends on your consultation. Please contact the team for details when arranging your appointment.
